purpose: Formalize the principle that distinction reorganizes admissibility within the same process.
canonical_statement: Distinction does not create a new process. Distinction creates deviated constraint within the same process.

definitions.deviated_constraint: constraint topology differs from prior organization

tire_track_form.reading: The track is the same topology reorganized.

vortex_form.V3: organization conditioned by V1 and V2

candidate_claim: Admissibility organization becomes a co-generator of future admissibility organization.

non_markov_candidate.claim: Future admissibility may depend on accumulated organization rather than only the immediately prior state.
